resources.string: For setups where the iPhone outputs audio directly (such as to a helmet headset or vehicle Bluetooth). Publishes playback info and handles controls without playing sound locally. Requires CarPlay audio through vehicle Bluetooth. Applies on the next connection.
Locks the home, settings and CarPlay screens. Changing this setting reconnects an active CarPlay session after confirmation. Auto restores the original rotation behaviour.
Converts Chinese song titles and artists to pinyin offline for motorcycle instruments that do not support Chinese text. CarPlay retains original text. Applies on the next connection.
Also convert album names when pinyin is enabled. Applies on the next connection.
Requires the pinyin switch. Match the full original iPhone artist name. Your display name overrides automatic pinyin. Leave it blank to remove a rule. Applies on the next connection.
Enter a valid name: up to 200 characters per name and 100 rules.

Requests audio focus when audio-free media controls are active, which helps some systems prioritize hardware media keys. May pause or lower other Android audio. Requires Disable media-key audio focus to be off. Applies on the next connection.
